summary: The candidate fixes host-independent backend-selection test isolation and adds an exact-shape direct _load_w13 sharding fixture, but changes no production code and does not exercise the initialization, post-load preprocessing, or SM90 runner contract associated with the original Hidden size mismatch.

tests.what_was_measured: Reproduced the candidate's stated test-harness failure: ROCm host state prevents the nominal SM100 case from selecting flashinfer_mxfp4. This is not the original checkpoint Hidden size mismatch.
Five tests and three subtests passed: isolated backend selection plus direct _load_w13 row sharding/order for four logical TP ranks.

tests.command: Independent inline _load_w13 adversarial cases for [2048,1024]/[2048,64] and [2048,2048]/[2048,127]
tests.what_was_measured: Both incompatible dimension combinations were accepted, demonstrating that the candidate fixture does not validate hidden-size or scale-width invariants.
Module skipped because the assigned accelerator is AMD gfx950, not NVIDIA SM90.

tests.command: Inline torch GPU matmul compared with CPU reference
tests.what_was_measured: A float32 matmul ran on AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 and matched the CPU reference; unrelated to FlashInfer Hopper qualification.

gpu_execution_evidence: reports/j-04973f3f7617/evidence/gpu.txt records AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 execution and a matching CPU reference.
remaining_counterexamples: The direct loader fixture accepts a packed weight width of 1024 and scale width of 64 just as it accepts the reported 2048/128 pair, because no model hidden size or runner contract is constructed.
The direct loader fixture accepts a 127-column scale tensor paired with a 2048-column packed weight, so it does not enforce the reported MXFP4 scale relationship.
No FlashInfer SM90 post-load preprocessing or kernel execution demonstrates that loaded/permuted expert dimensions satisfy the Hopper contract.
No full DeepSeek-V4 checkpoint load reproduces or clears the original Hidden size mismatch.
remaining_limitations: NVIDIA H800/SM90 hardware was unavailable; the assigned GPU was an AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950.
Only logical per-rank TP=4 slicing was tested, not four-process distributed TP=4 execution.
Full serving, DSPARK, HTTP transport, and semantic accuracy were not tested.
The candidate changes no native code; a native rebuild was not applicable.
